english.note: Central admission minimum; program may require higher. Graduate-assistant eligibility minima: TOEFL5 overall with Listening/Speaking5 (old scale100 with25 each), IELTS7 overall with Listening7/Speaking7.5, or Duolingo135 overall with Listening135/Speaking145. Tests valid two years. Exemption: native English or qualifying degree within five years in a listed exempt country; English-medium education elsewhere is not sufficient under this policy.

applicationFee.note: Limited fee scholarships for applicants who qualify as permanent Hawaiʻi residents and/or recently earned a University of Hawaiʻi bachelor’s degree, and complete the application. Confirm eligibility; no general international waiver established.

documents: Program questions naming faculty interests and research experience
requirements.note: Minimum recommended GPA3.2; University minimum3.0. Strong life-science undergraduate/MS preparation expected. Research experience recommended rather than required. Applicants select the PhD degree track; new students immediately join a laboratory.

funding.note: Program advises applicants to seek external fellowships, including the International Fulbright Foreign Student Program. No universal program-funded package or current stipend verified.
